test_type: Real authenticated HTTP APIs, actual configured LLM invocation, immutable PostgreSQL regression binding, independent Chromium candidate verification, screenshot proof, two-phase human-role approval and replay of approved baseline
limitations: This is one genuine configured-model example with one unique proposal, not proof of accuracy across arbitrary sites or all three possible candidate choices.
User-role approval was conducted through authenticated two-phase HTTP APIs, not by clicking through the browser UI.
Verification covers a single-origin, non-submitting, anonymous fixture and frozen result oracle. It does not establish credentialed cross-origin auto-healing.
Continuous browser images are limited to approved anonymous non-submitting runs and are not 24fps video.
Existing six-way 3000-session Chromium-layer soak (~349 seconds) does not constitute several hours of full orchestrator/model end-to-end load testing.
